author: fester
body: The IR spells a record field as name/slot, the physical slot index riding behind a slash (`IRTextEmitter.codex`, ir-field-with-index). Only the name is the Python attribute. Without the strip a field access renders as a division: slot 0 raises ZeroDivisionError, and slot 1 divides by one and is silently correct, which is how this survived until a record reached the plug oracle.
